newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Cricket - Rain delays Australia v India match again.
newsitem.headline: Cricket - Rain delays Australia v India match again.

text.p: Early morning showers have delayed the start of Australia's vital Singer World Series limited overs match against India for the second day in succession.
The match, which will decide who will play hosts Sri Lanka in Saturday's final, was originally scheduled for Thursday but postponed until Friday due to rain in Colombo.
Cricket officials said chances for play were brighter on Friday.
But if Friday's match is also washed out, Australia will go through to the final because of their superior run rate.
